StoryImages 6

A six-month program

Viam has detailed Launchpad, a six-month robotics incubator for cohorts of five to ten companies, with engineering, laboratory and business support. The article was written by Oliver Mitchell, the program’s advising executive director, a role readers should consider when assessing its claims.

Resources for integration

The program website lists more than $100,000 in resources and services, including $30,000 of platform credits. Teams can access a New York robotics lab, integration engineers and mentors, covering fleet management, data, updates and remote troubleshooting.

Deployment is a goal

The aim is a product or customer pilot and preparation for fundraising. RoboBuilt’s example describes a planned commercial installation, not a confirmed outcome for every cohort. Applications are rolling, and the advertised resource value is not a cash investment paid to every team.
